juni.name: Juni
juni.title: Tender
intro: Juni: Rowan! Told you I'd beat you up here. Let's see what your new friend can do!
defeat: Juni: Wow. Okay. You two really click, huh?
after: Juni: Next time I'm winning. Hey, the stream's dry, but you can hear something under the bridge...

lio.name: Lio
lio.title: Forager
intro: Lio: Foraging's been poor since the Hush. Let's see if you've got the heart for the grove!
defeat: Lio: Ha! You've got heart, all right. The grove's just north of here.
after: Lio: Thistlehogs love Sunberries. Sleepy wildkin like a soft word more than a snack.
